scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance for Performance of Marriage of Poor Brides Living Below Poverty Line
other_conditions: Assistance is payable only for the first marriage of the bride
Marriage must be performed in accordance with the law in force on the date of marriage
Assistance is given for the performance of the marriage of one daughter only
Bridegroom must be at least 21 years old on the date of marriage
Parents or guardian of the bride must be Indian citizens
Parents or guardian must be native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence of five years or more
Application must be submitted at least 30 days before the proposed marriage date
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 for marriage expenses.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
